milestone.describes: The main menu is drawn and stays up: the title art with PLAY, RESUME, SOCIAL, SCORES and HELP down the right-hand side, the whole frame rendered the right way up and the right way round.

steps.expect: The main menu: Fieldrunners title art with PLAY, RESUME, SOCIAL, SCORES and HELP stacked on the right.
The menu is still there and the app has not stopped. Its log keeps ticking drawables, so it is running rather than frozen at the last frame it managed.

notes: Coordinates would be client coordinates for the 480x320 landscape window; this route has no taps yet.
No launch options are needed: the app declares iPhone only and comes up landscape by itself.

This build reached the menu for the first time on `e643eb3e`. Before `fix/fs-rename-directory` it aborted tapHLE during start-up, because it moves a directory and moving a directory was not implemented.
The log fills with `Call to faked class "OpenFeint"` lines every frame. That is the social-network SDK being absent rather than anything going wrong, and it is what the SOCIAL button leads to.
